release_rules: No public source URL, site identity, schedule, GPS point, Mass use, operator, ownership, rite or liturgical book is changed by this dossier.

Do not infer a current Mass or its celebrant from a linked institutional address.
Legacy HTTP-only sources are preserved verbatim for provenance; no unverified automatic HTTPS rewrite.
The six self-referential links are not first-party witnesses; external-search fallback is an expressly unverified lookup, not source evidence.
